methods.gate_clock: Earliest matching PR workflow creation for latest sampled PR head to last successful required check completion. Not push time or auto-merge readiness.
methods.sample: 60 equally spaced PR numbers from 232 PRs updated in window; 47 have devel base and latest-head PR workflow within window.
methods.occupancy: Completed assigned jobs clipped to window; lower bound. Includes runs created before window only when collected as unfinished; excludes unfinished executions.
methods.rerun_normalization: Deduplicate identical run/name/runner/start/end executions (carried-forward GitHub rerun job aliases), keep smallest job ID; original metadata retained locally.
methods.source: Pinned devel source inspected; per-run synthetic merge SHA separately recorded.
